name: The passive participle
definition: A noun derived from a verb for the one to whom the act is done, such as manṣūr (helped) from naṣara.
body: From the bare verb it is on the pattern مَفْعُولٌ: مَنْصُورٌ، مَضْرُوبٌ، مَكْتُوبٌ (written). From the added patterns it is like the active participle, but with a fatḥa before the last letter: مُكْرَمٌ (honoured), مُعَلَّمٌ (taught).
